fronts.name: Player Experience / Session / Onboarding / UX / Cue Design

ownedClosures.name: Player Experience Promise
ownedClosures.oracle: real Human consequence eventually matches intended tracking/observation experience

ownedClosures.name: Session / Flow
ownedClosures.oracle: fresh launch through loop completion/recoverable failure/replay is coherent

ownedClosures.name: Multimodal Cue / Information Design
ownedClosures.oracle: shared creature/world state yields coherent learnable visual-motion-audio-trace feedback without trivializing search or relying on one inaccessible modality

ownedClosures.name: Onboarding / Learnability
ownedClosures.oracle: fresh player can learn basic interaction/cue model without developer coaching

ownedClosures.name: UX
ownedClosures.oracle: player can understand and complete the intended task under exact condition

role.mission: Independently own player-experience promise, session flow, onboarding, UX/task-completion hypotheses and multimodal information/cue design. Preserve Human-unknown boundaries.
firstVerdictMustAddress: whether scope should split before implementation
mustNotReadBeforeFirstVerdict: A23 current-round red-team verdict unless you are A23
prohibitedAuthority: Do not convert expert opinion into Human evidence.
role.stopCondition: validated handoff OR formal blocker OR contradicted/inconclusive standing OR authority/apparatus gate OR justified scope split
